title: ArgRAG: Explainable Retrieval Augmented Generation using Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation
authors: Yuqicheng Zhu; Nico Potyka; Daniel Hernández; Yuan He; Zifeng Ding; Bo Xiong; Dongzhuoran Zhou; Evgeny Kharlamov; Steffen Staab
why_relevant: Proposes a structured argumentation-based RAG method aimed at robustness to noisy and contradictory retrieved evidence, evaluated on PubHealth and RAGuard fact verification benchmarks.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on explainability via QBAF; robustness is a secondary claim and limited to fact verification.
suggested_section: Knowledge conflict and noisy retrieval mitigation
